name: Talifhani Nemaangani
desc: Talifhani Nemaangani is an Electrical Engineering master’s student at the University of Cape Town, with a strong interest in wireless communications, 5G networks, and satellite-based connectivity. His current research focuses on handover performance in 5G NR Non-Terrestrial Networks using Low Earth Orbit satellites and OpenAirInterface-based testbeds. His interests include telecommunications, software-defined radio, network experimentation, and the development of software solutions.
